_comment: Symphony Playing Exam #3, posted by the Post Assignment workflow.
Nutcracker Act II only, and nothing from No. 14 or No. 15 (those were Exam 2).
Bar numbers are the NWSA library stamps in the Hub part books (restart each movement).
title: Symphony Playing Exam #3
description:
This playing exam is due **Tuesday, November 3rd, by the end of the day.** Late exams cannot be submitted or accepted through any other method except this hub.

State your name and grade level at the beginning of your video. Points will be deducted if this is not done. Your video must show the entire playing area and cannot be edited with cuts.

Everything is from Tchaikovsky, *The Nutcracker*, Act II. Bar numbers are the ones printed in your Hub part. They restart at every movement.

__Violin 1__
No. 11 Scene: measure 88 through the downbeat of measure 116 (rehearsal 19).

__Violin 2__
No. 12d Trepak: beginning through the end.

__Viola__
No. 11 Scene: measure 86 through the downbeat of measure 116 (rehearsal 19).

__Cello__
No. 12d Trepak: measure 32 through the end.

__Bass__
No. 12d Trepak: measure 32 through the end.

__Flute__
No. 12e Dance of the Reed Flutes (Mirlitons): beginning through measure 26. All play Flute 1.

__Oboe__
No. 12a Chocolate: measures 52 (rehearsal 24) through 68. Then No. 12d Trepak: measure 49 (rehearsal 35) through the end. All play Oboe 1.

__Clarinet__
No. 12c Tea: measure 19 (rehearsal 33) through the end. Then No. 13 Waltz of the Flowers: measures 45 (Solo) through 69, on A clarinet. All play Clarinet 1.

__Bassoon__
No. 12c Tea: beginning through the end. Both play Bassoon 1.

__Piano/Celesta__
No. 11 Scene: beginning through measure 20. Celesta part (the celesta book labels this movement "No 8 Scene").

__Percussion__
Timpani, No. 11 Scene: measure 84 through the downbeat of measure 116. Then Tambourine, No. 12d Trepak: measure 54 through the end. Everyone plays both.

__Horn__
No. 13 Waltz of the Flowers: measures 1 through 17, then measures 38 (Soli) through 61. All play Horn 1.

__Trumpet__
No. 12a Chocolate: measures 5 through 20. Then No. 12e Dance of the Reed Flutes: pickup in measure 42 through the downbeat of measure 60 (rehearsal 41). All play Trumpet 1.

__Tenor Trombone__
No. 11 Scene: measures 88 through 125. Trombone 1 part.

__Bass Trombone/Tuba__
No. 11 Scene: measure 85 (rehearsal 17) through the downbeat of measure 116. Tuba part.

__Tenor Saxophone__
No. 12c Tea: measure 19 (rehearsal 33) through the end. Read the Bass Clarinet part as written.

__Banjo/Guitar__
No. 13 Waltz of the Flowers, Harp part, top line only: measure 122 (rehearsal 57) through measure 139 (end of the 1st ending), then measures 278 through 284.

__Harp__
No. 13 Waltz of the Flowers: measure 3 through measure 33, including the full cadenza. Harp 1 part.
